deployments_detail.use: Vision-recognition AI + LLM for hydraulic excavator near-miss auto-detection, summarization & reporting (with NEC, Apr 2026)

IZANA: AI (machine learning) operation-support system for next-generation biomass / circulating fluidized bed (CFB) boiler power plants. Diagnoses live plant operating data to detect equipment issues early and advise operators on stable operation. Runs on SHI's SHICuTe ICT/IoT platform. [Sumitomo Heavy Industries (in-house ML, Technology Research Center)]

AI fault-prediction for industrial machinery: deep-learning system to detect early signs of ball-screw damage in electric plastic injection-molding machine drive mechanisms; also aimed at product quality判定 and auto-adjustment of operating conditions. [NEC (RAPID machine learning / NEC the WISE)]
deployments_detail.value: learns 1500 datasets in ~20 min; classifies normal vs damaged at <=0.4 sec/dataset

deployments_detail.use: Construction-site safety AI: video-recognition AI plus generative AI (LLM) to automatically detect near-miss (hiyari-hatto) events around hydraulic excavators from camera/sensor data and auto-generate summarized incident reports. PoC Sept 2025; joint development from April 2026. [NEC (video recognition AI + LLM)]

KITOV-ONE AI visual/appearance inspection system offered by SHI Mechatronics: 3D imaging + proprietary image-processing algorithms and OCR to detect 100-micron-level scratches, dents, hair, loose screws and labeling errors on complex/glossy parts in high-mix low-volume production. [Sumitomo Heavy Industries Mechatronics (KITOV-ONE, based on Kitov.ai tech)]

AI-driven automatic adjustment of injection-molding parameters during mass production: collects temperature/pressure/speed data and uses ML to auto-tune molding conditions in real time to stabilize quality (incl. recycled materials) and reduce defects/labor. Shown at Nov 2024 Nagoya exhibition; reference technology, release TBD. [Sumitomo Heavy Industries (Plastics Machinery)]

Machine-learning development on the SHICuTe common platform requiring large-scale data annotation (images, time-series waveforms, natural language) to build ML systems that diagnose operational data; annotation outsourced to Science Co. to scale training-data production. [Science Co., Ltd. (annotation services); SHI SHICuTe platform]

1paper AI translation service adopted so R&D engineers can read English/German academic papers in Japanese (OCR + auto layout reconstruction), speeding overseas technical-literature intake for product development. [Feynma Technology (1paper; DeepL engine)]
deployments_detail.value: papers translated in ~1 minute; up to 100,000 characters per translation

deployments_detail.use: CADDi Drawer manufacturing-data-utilization cloud deployed at Sumitomo Heavy Industries Construction Crane (HSC): AI drawing analysis and similarity search across technical drawings/specs to consolidate duplicate part numbers, transfer engineering knowledge, and cut inventory; expanding to production tech, painting, QA departments. [CADDi (CADDi Drawer)]

Microsoft 365 Copilot ('Meet my Copilot' case): energy/environment division uses Copilot for knowledge transfer and creation of employee training/education materials in quality-control and product-inspection work, reducing instructor workload (OJT augmentation). [Microsoft (Microsoft 365 Copilot)]
